slippage.stop: min(stop, bar low). The low is a trade print, not a bid.
slippage.target: the limit, only after a print trades at or above it. Not an ask.
slippage.flatten: that minute's close print, not a bid.
slippage.same_minute: if low reaches the stop and high reaches the target, the stop fills.
slippage.size: original quantity. Skip when one lot risks more than $175. Never upsize.

fill_arithmetic.note: Recorded P&L versus (exit-entry)*100*qty. This does not use bars.

fill_versus_print.note: Whether the recorded price sits inside that minute's print high/low. Neighbor minutes are not used.

verdict.reason: The archive has 16 weekdays. That cannot meet a 20-session gate. Minute prints also cannot show that a staged or rejected live sell would have filled.
